rationale: Full independent Opus review (2026-10-20) against the held source texts, with an explicit D6 step. Accept, with defect; the NO status stands. Held EO 11796 (39 FR 27891, July 30, 1974) continues EO 11533 and the export rules under sec. 5(b) of the 1917 act after the Export Administration Act lapsed; it has no own term. Held EO 11798 (39 FR 29567, Aug. 14, 1974) sec. 1 revokes EO 11796 by number and date. Its only exception saves past violations, not the order. Sec. 2 continues EO 11533 under P.L. 93-372, not EO 11796. D6: a search of all 6,652 held full-run FR texts and the APP texts for '11796' finds only EO 11796 and EO 11798. EOs 11810, 11940 and 11978 are held and do not name EO 11796. I read held EO 12002 (July 7, 1977). Its sec. 7 revokes EO 11798, but it does not name EO 11796 and has no revival wording. Its sec. 6 keeps only actions taken under, or continued by, the revoked orders, so EO 11796 is not revived. Defect: the rationale says EO 12002 is held only as the APP transcription with no FR original. In fact an FR original is held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12002.txt (42 FR 35623-24, OCR). That text matches secs. 6 and 7 as quoted, so the conclusion is unaffected. The first end is Aug. 14, 1974.
